Find Your Calm at Lotus & Light Yoga

Tucked away in the heart of Riverdale, Lotus & Light Yoga is a quiet sanctuary where breath, movement, and stillness meet. Whether you are stepping onto a mat for the first time or deepening a lifelong practice, our studio welcomes you exactly as you are.

Book a Trial Class View Pricing

Why Practice With Us

Experienced, Caring Teachers

Our instructors bring decades of combined experience in Hatha, Vinyasa, and restorative traditions, guiding every student with patience and attention.

Classes for Every Body

From gentle morning stretches to energizing power flows, our schedule offers a class for every level, age, and ability.

A Peaceful, Welcoming Space

Natural light, warm wood floors, and the scent of sandalwood create a calm environment where you can truly unwind.

Understanding Our Class Styles

Not sure which class is right for you? Here's a quick guide to each style we offer so you can choose the pace and focus that suits you best.

Sunrise Vinyasa

A dynamic, breath-linked flow to wake up the body and mind. Expect continuous movement, building heat, and an energizing start to your day.

Hatha Flow

A slower-paced class focusing on foundational postures held for longer, ideal for building strength, alignment, and confidence with the basics.

Power Vinyasa

A challenging, athletic practice that combines strength work with flowing sequences. Best suited to students with some prior yoga experience.

Yin Yoga

Long-held, passive floor postures that target deep connective tissue. A meditative, quiet practice that complements more active styles.

Restorative Yoga

Fully supported poses using bolsters and blankets to encourage deep rest and nervous-system recovery. Gentle and suitable for all bodies.

Community Flow

Our donation-based Saturday class, open to all levels, followed by tea and conversation in the studio lounge.

Our Teachers

Every class at Lotus & Light Yoga is guided by an instructor who has spent years refining their own practice before sharing it with others. Our teachers bring a range of styles, training lineages, and personalities to the mat — but they share a common commitment to patience, safety, and genuine care for every student who walks through our doors.

Meet the Team

Maya Chen

Vinyasa & Hatha

Maya discovered yoga while recovering from a running injury over a decade ago and never looked back. She holds a 500-hour certification from the Riverdale School of Yoga and loves building sequences that build strength while staying playful. Her classes often end with a long, well-earned savasana.

David Okafor

Power Yoga & Alignment

A former competitive swimmer, David brings an athlete's attention to alignment and breath control to his Power Yoga classes. He trained in Mysore, India, and is known for offering hands-on adjustments (always with permission) that help students find new depth in familiar poses.

Priya Patel

Restorative & Yin Yoga

Priya's slow, prop-supported classes are a favorite among students looking to unwind after a long week. She studied under a yin yoga master in Bali and believes that true flexibility begins with a quiet mind. Expect blankets, bolsters, and plenty of stillness.

Lena Novak

Prenatal Yoga

Lena is a certified prenatal and postnatal yoga instructor with a background in physical therapy. She created our prenatal program to give expecting parents a safe, supportive space to stay active and connect with their changing bodies throughout every trimester.

Marcus Reyes

Meditation & Breathwork

Marcus leads our Sunday meditation and breathwork sessions, drawing on fifteen years of Zen practice and formal training in pranayama. His calm, grounded voice has helped countless students build a sustainable meditation habit, one breath at a time.

Curious About Our Classes?

Every one of our teachers welcomes beginners with open arms. Browse the weekly timetable to find a class that fits your schedule and style.

Pricing & Billing Questions

How does billing work for Monthly Unlimited?

Your card is charged automatically on the same date each month. You can update your payment method or cancel at any time from your account, with no long-term contract required.

Can I cancel or pause my membership?

Yes. Monthly and annual members can pause their membership for up to 8 weeks per year (great for travel or injury recovery) or cancel with 7 days' notice before the next billing date.

Do class packs expire?

5-Class Packs are valid for 3 months from the date of purchase. We're happy to extend a pack by a few weeks if life gets in the way — just ask us at the front desk.

Is there a student or senior discount?

Yes, we offer 15% off any membership for students and seniors (65+) with valid ID. Discounts can be applied when you sign up in person or by mentioning it through our contact form.

What if I miss a class I booked?

Please cancel your reservation at least 2 hours in advance through our booking system to free the spot for others. Late cancellations on class packs may count as a used class.
